tasks.CalculateEligibleVoters: Calculate the number of eligible voters out of 5000 total voters where 20% are not eligible to vote.
tasks.CalculateTotalVotesForWinner: Compute the total number of votes received by the winning candidate based on the margin calculated in the previous step.
tasks.CalculateWinningMarginVotes: Determine the margin by which the winning candidate won, given that they won by 15% of the votes cast.
